thread:
alex: FYI customer reported an API call that ended up cancelling the shipment instead of refunding the order. Looks like a tool selection issue from the resolver.

maya: ugh. do we have a repro? link to the request body?

alex: pasted below — note the model-run used function calling and picked shipment.cancel. customer expected order.issue_refund.

alex: ```json
POST /v1/assistant/call
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "assistant-v1",
  "input": "please cancel order 98765 and refund it",
  "tools": ["order.issue_refund", "shipment.cancel"],
  "tool_selector": "auto"
}
```

sam_ops: do we have the tool signatures? maybe the schema is similar so the model picked shipment.cancel because it matched 'cancel' intent.

irene: here's the registry snippet from production:

irene: ```json
[
  {
    "name": "order.issue_refund",
    "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["id"] }
  },
  {
    "name": "shipment.cancel",
    "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "id": { "type": "string" } }, "required": ["id"] }
  }
]
```

maya: identical single-field schemas, yeah that explains it. model has no signal which id is which.

support-bot: @channel alert: 2 incidents this morning where shipment.cancel was executed but customer expected an order refund. Severity: medium.

alex: repro steps I used: 1) call assistant with natural text including 'refund' and 'order' 2) tool_selector=auto 3) observe function call: shipment.cancel({"id":"98765"}) 4) shipment service returned 200 and that triggered carrier pickup request.

sam_ops: logs show model output selecting shipment.cancel at 1719004350. we then executed the tool with args {"id":"98765"}.

irene: quick mitigation: prefer longest-match by tool name tokens (order vs shipment) or require explicit resource_type in schema. longer-term: add disambiguation prompt to model when multiple tools share identical JSON schemas.

maya: can we patch the selector now? simplest: order.issue_refund should be promoted when input contains words refund/credit/refund_amount; shipment.cancel promoted for words pickup/carrier/shipment.

alex: customer is angry because shipment pickup started. we should offer immediate rollback: cancel the carrier pickup and issue manual refund. I've emailed ops to stop pickup.

sam_ops: created ticket OPS-4512 to reverse pickup and perform manual refund. also adding a selector rule for refund keywords.

irene: propose small schema change to order.issue_refund: require "resource_type": "order" as a constant enum so schemas are not identical. that will force the model to prefer the correct tool.

maya: test plan: 1) add enum field to order.issue_refund schema 2) deploy to staging 3) run 50 randomized prompts with 'cancel/refund' 'order' 'shipment' combos 4) verify tool_choice accuracy before go.

alex: thanks. customer support update: sent apology + manual refund ETA 2h. will follow up after ops completes rollback.

support-bot: incident updated OPS-4512, severity lowered to low after manual rollback initiated. :white_check_mark:

sam_ops: note for product: when registering new tools, please avoid identical single-field schemas — include a discriminator or nested object. filing a docs PR.

irene: filing RFC for selector improvements + disambiguation dialog (RFC-2026). assigning to @maya for selector heuristics.

maya: on it. I'll also add a short-term guard: if tool_selector=auto and two candidate tools have identical schema, prefer the one with keywords that match the input; if tie, require explicit confirm step.

alex: leaving this thread with the customer follow-up done. will close once refund completes.
